title: Multi-class Hierarchical Question Classification for Multiple Choice Science Exams
answer_short: The dataset was constructed by annotating 7,787 questions over approximately 8 weeks, with two annotators using a two-stage process to ensure high-quality classification annotation.
answer_rationale: Text 2 (page=13, section=Annotation) describes the annotation procedure, stating that annotation took place over 8 weeks with two annotators, using a two-stage process to resolve disagreements and ensure quality. This directly addresses how the dataset was collected.
